title: The Phase-2 interfaces refuse what they exist to refuse
note: ScientificModel, ModelRegistry, ResultBundle, VerificationResult, Observation kinds, Quantity (the generic D-2026-69 mechanism), run identity, implementation identity, and cut C1. Each mutation removes one refusal.
